coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Two of five ground-truth variable items are matched at a conceptual level: comparison of ground-truth, subsampled, and MDGEN-generated trajectories, and measurement of torsional autocorrelation. Neither match preserves all required numerical details.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output replaces the pooled 30k-frame test-peptide dataset with new simulations, omits fixed training crops of up to 256 residues, every-40-frame training subsampling, and full-protein inference. It uses 1–2 fs reference/generated resolution rather than 100 fs and introduces multiple subsampling intervals instead of the specified 10 ps comparison. Its autocorrelation is normalized differently and evaluated over 0–5 ps rather than 100 fs–100 ps. Dynamic content, defined as the negative derivative of autocorrelation with respect to log-timescale, is missing.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion states that MDGEN should recover sub-ps oscillations, closely match ground-truth autocorrelation, and exhibit non-monotonic dynamic content, whereas subsampled trajectories lack these features.
